name: Tray.io
tagline: Tray.io is a general automation platform for enterprises with a visual workflow builder and native AI capabilities. Its Merlin AI assistant helps users build automation workflows from natural language descriptions and recommends improvements to existing automations. It connects to 600+ apps with enterprise-grade security.
